questions: RULED (DEC-128): « variété » is read paracompact. The non-paracompact case is a REMARK in SCOPE, not a finding or an OQ: the bundle route needs paracompactness; a Hausdorff manifold containing an embedded long ray carries no locally projective (nor affine) structure (every continuous map from a long ray to Sⁿ is eventually constant, so no developing map); the remaining Prüfer/Moore-type case (non-paracompact, no long ray) is open and unformalized.

Two ChartedSpace instances on one type with DIFFERENT models are safe (the model is an explicit non-outParam argument; `chartAt _ x` is stuck, never a silent pick); never add a generic instance producing one of them for a whole class of types — use the abbrev with letI.
notes: FCone gets a GLOBAL instance ChartedSpace (Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (FCone n B) (and HasGroupoid affGroupoid), kept global by DEC-128. Never generalise it to all affine conical manifolds (use affineChartedSpace with letI).
